subject: JUSTIFIED clause
notes: "The JUSTIFIED clause shall not be specified for a dynamic-length elementary item." (cite.py --check 13.18.32.3 -> OK §13.18.32.3 4)). §8.5.1.10.1: a dynamic-length elementary item "is defined by the DYNAMIC LENGTH clause"; Annex E.3 (2023 changes) lists only a SET enhancement for dynamic-length items, so they pre-exist 2023 -> editions 2014, 2023.
